a playful jump or a pickled bud
an alloy of copper and tin
an alloy of copper and zinc
a hard material that conducts heat and power
entries.definitionCN: 能导热导电的坚硬材料

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a warm red wire, then move to small coins and to a British officer.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一根暖红的电线开始，再到小面值硬币，最后到英国警察。

normal.en: Copper the metal, copper the coin, copper the officer: one word, three red-brown things.
normal.cn: 铜、铜币、警察：一个词，三样带红褐色意味的东西。

normal.en: The metal is named after Cyprus, so think of a sunny island.
normal.cn: 这种金属因塞浦路斯得名，可以想成一座阳光岛。

normal.en: Copper wire bends easily, which is why old houses still use it.
normal.cn: 铜线容易弯，所以老房子至今还在用。

normal.en: The slang officer and the metal share one word by accident of history.
normal.cn: 俚语里的警察与这种金属，因历史的巧合共用一个词。

normal.en: Say cop plus per to keep the two p sounds apart.
normal.cn: 读作 cop 加 per，把两个 p 音分开。

abstract.en: Picture a coil of wire glowing under a lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象灯下一卷发亮的电线。

abstract.en: Picture a palm full of small brown coins.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掌里盛满褐色小硬币。

abstract.en: Picture a green roof turning red brown with age.
abstract.cn: 想象铜屋顶随着岁月由绿转成红褐。

examples.en: The old pot is lined with copper.
examples.cn: 这口旧锅内壁衬着铜。

examples.en: He saved every copper in a tin.
examples.cn: 他把每一枚铜币都存进一个铁罐。

examples.en: A copper stood at the end of the lane.
examples.cn: 一名警察站在小巷尽头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 copper 记成 cop 加 per：警察制服上的纽扣常是铜的，铜与警察就共用这个词。

root: 源自拉丁语 cuprum，为 Cyprium aes（塞浦路斯的金属）的缩写，因古代铜矿多采自塞浦路斯岛，后引申出铜币与警察等义。

sensesIntro.en: From a metal named after an island, to the small coin made from it, and to a slang name for an officer.
sensesIntro.cn: 从以岛命名的金属，到用它铸成的小硬币，最后到警察的俚语称呼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bare copper wire shining warm red.
core.cn: 核心意象：一截裸铜线泛着暖红的光。

branches.en: A soft red metal runs through wires and pipes.
branches.cn: 一种柔软的红金属穿行在电线与管道里。

branches.en: The same metal once made the smallest money.
branches.cn: 同一种金属曾铸成最小的钱币。

branches.en: Slang borrows the word for an officer who catches people.
branches.cn: 俚语借这个词来称抓人的警察。

branches.en: Metal and coin are linked by what the coin is made of.
branches.cn: 金属与硬币由铸币材料连在一起。

branches.en: Both extra senses grew in everyday British speech.
branches.cn: 两个引申义都生长于英国日常口语。

intro.en: Copper rests on Latin cuprum, from the island name Cyprus, and takes -y and -plate in English.
intro.cn: copper 源于拉丁语 cuprum，出自岛名塞浦路斯，在英语里又能加 -y 与 -plate。

latinIntro.en: The copper base cupr- also appears in cuprous and cupric, the two chemical forms.
latinIntro.cn: 铜的词基 cupr- 也出现在 cuprous 与 cupric 这两个化学用语中。

items.meaning: like copper in colour or taste
items.meaningCN: 在颜色或味道上像铜的
items.example: Her hair had a coppery shine.
items.exampleCN: 她的头发有铜色的光泽。

items.meaning: a plate of copper used for printing
items.example: The map was printed from copperplate.
items.exampleCN: 这幅地图是用铜版印的。

items.meaning: containing copper in a low form
containing copper in a higher form

definition_zh: 副本；一份；复制；抄写；模仿
definition_en: a duplicate of something, one example of a publication, or to make a duplicate
core_image: 一张纸从原件下面抽出，墨迹还带着余温
scene: 图书馆只剩一本，管理员把它复印了一份留档。She copied the page before handing the book back.
sceneCN: 这里 copy 指「复制」（第 3 个义项：做出与原物相同的另一份）；句意是她在还书之前把那一页复制了一份。

senses.title: A duplicate
senses.definition: a thing made to be exactly like another thing
senses.definitionCN: 照原物做成的一模一样的东西
senses.example: Keep a copy of your form.
senses.exampleCN: 留一份表格副本。
senses.why: The second sheet carries the same words but not the same hand.
senses.whyCN: 第二张纸带着同样的字，却不是同一只手写下的。

senses.title: One example of a publication
senses.definition: one single book, paper or record out of many printed
senses.definitionCN: 许多印本中的单独一本、一份或一张
senses.example: The shop had only two copies left.
senses.exampleCN: 店里只剩两份了。
senses.why: A print run becomes many objects, and each object is counted.
senses.whyCN: 一次印刷变成许多实物，每一件都要计数。

senses.title: To make a duplicate
senses.definition: to make something that looks the same as an original
senses.definitionCN: 做出一个与原物看起来相同的东西
senses.example: Copy the passage into your notebook.
senses.exampleCN: 把这段话抄进你的笔记本。
senses.why: Copying is following a path someone else has already walked.
senses.whyCN: 复制就是走一条别人已经走过的路。

intro.en: Copy comes from Latin copia, plenty, through Medieval Latin copia, a transcript, because copying made many texts from one.
intro.cn: copy 来自拉丁语 copia（丰富），经中世纪拉丁语 copia（抄本）演变而来，因为抄写能让一份文本变成许多份。

items.en: Copia meant abundance or a large supply.
items.cn: copia 意为丰富或大量供应。

items.en: The phrase copia libri meant an abundance of copies of a book.
items.cn: 短语 copia libri 意为某书的大量抄本。

items.en: Copia came to mean a single transcript of a text.
items.cn: copia 转而指一份文本的抄本。

items.en: Old French copie named a written copy of a document.
items.cn: 古法语 copie 指文件的书面抄本。

items.en: English copy first meant a transcript, not an original.
items.cn: 英语 copy 最初指抄本，而不是原件。

items.en: Printing and then machines widened it to any duplicate.
items.cn: 印刷术与后来的机器把它扩大到任何复制品。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short cop- base, and the meaning group names other words for making or matching a thing.
note.cn: 形近组共享短短的 cop- 词基，近义组列出其他表示复制或仿制的词。

entries.definition: a police officer in informal speech
to deal with a hard situation
the legal right over a work
entries.definitionCN: 对作品享有的法律权利

entries.definition: an exact second version of something
entries.definitionCN: 某物一模一样的第二份

entries.definition: to make a copy of something
to copy the way someone acts

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a second sheet under the first, then move to many printed books and to a hand following another hand.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从第一张纸下面的第二张开始，再到许多印本，最后到一只手跟着另一只手写。

normal.en: Copy begins with cop, to seize, as if the second sheet snatches the look of the first.
normal.cn: copy 开头是 cop（抓住），仿佛第二张纸抢走了第一张的样子。

normal.en: One original, many copies: the word once meant plenty.
normal.cn: 一个原件，许多副本：这个词最初就带着丰富的意思。

normal.en: A copy of a book is one object; a copy of a file is one more set of bits.
normal.cn: 一本书的一份是一件实物；一个文件的一份是一组多出来的数据。

normal.en: Copying for study is learning; copying to cheat is theft.
normal.cn: 为学习而抄是学习，为作弊而抄是偷窃。

normal.en: Remember the spelling change: copy becomes copies and copied.
normal.cn: 记住拼写变化：copy 变成 copies 与 copied。

abstract.en: Picture two sheets sliding apart with one image on both.
abstract.cn: 想象两张纸滑开，上面却是同一个图案。

abstract.en: Picture a shelf of identical books side by side.
abstract.cn: 想象书架上并排摆着一模一样的书。

abstract.en: Picture a hand tracing letters slowly under a lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象灯下一只手慢慢描着字母。

examples.en: Please make three copies of this page.
examples.cn: 请把这一页复制三份。

examples.en: He copied the notes from the board.
examples.cn: 他把黑板上的笔记抄了下来。

examples.en: That dress copies a design from the sixties.
examples.cn: 那条裙子模仿了六十年代的一款设计。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 copy 记成 cop（抓）加 y：把原物的样子抓过来一份，就是复制与副本。

root: 源自拉丁语 copia（丰富），经中世纪拉丁语义项抄本与古法语 copie 演变而来，由多份抄本引申出副本与复制之义。

sensesIntro.en: From plenty of transcripts, to one printed object, and at last to the act of following an original.
sensesIntro.cn: 从大量的抄本，到单独一份印本，最后到跟随原件的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a second sheet pulled from under the first.
core.cn: 核心意象：从第一张纸下面抽出的第二张纸。

branches.en: A second thing matches the first in every visible way.
branches.cn: 第二件东西在可见之处都与第一件相合。

branches.en: One printed object is counted out of a large run.
branches.cn: 一次大批印刷中的单独一件被数出来。

branches.en: A hand or a machine repeats what was already there.
branches.cn: 一只手或一台机器重复已有的东西。

branches.en: The thing and the act are two sides of one idea.
branches.cn: 成品与动作是同一个想法的两面。

branches.en: A single copy is just one duplicate among many.
branches.cn: 单独一份，不过是许多复制品中的一个。

intro.en: Copy came from Latin copia, plenty, and grew the endings -er, -ist and -able in English.
intro.cn: copy 来自拉丁语 copia（丰富），在英语里长出 -er、-ist 与 -able 等词尾。

latinIntro.en: The same root copia, plenty, also gives copious and copiously.
latinIntro.cn: 同一个词根 copia（丰富）也产生了 copious 与 copiously。

items.meaning: a duplicate or one printed item

items.exampleCN: 一名抄写员抄了那卷书。

items.meaning: the legal right over a work
items.meaningCN: 对作品享有的法律权利

definition_zh: 版权；著作权；取得版权；受版权保护的
definition_en: the legal right to control copies of a work, or to protect a work in this way
core_image: 书页背面一枚小小的符号，圈住了作者的名字
scene: 她把乐谱寄给出版社之前，先去登记了权利。The composer copyrighted the song before it was played.
sceneCN: 这里 copyright 指「取得版权」（第 2 个义项：为作品办理版权保护）；句意是作曲家在歌曲演奏之前先取得了它的版权。

senses.title: The legal right over a work
senses.definition: the exclusive legal right to publish and copy a work
senses.definitionCN: 出版与复制某作品所专有的法律权利
senses.example: The copyright belongs to the author.
senses.exampleCN: 版权归作者所有。
senses.why: A made thing needs a fence, or others will carry it away.
senses.whyCN: 做出来的东西需要一道篱笆，否则会被别人搬走。

senses.title: To secure that right
senses.definition: to register or claim the legal right over a work
senses.definitionCN: 为作品登记或主张法律上的专有权
senses.example: They copyrighted the design last year.
senses.exampleCN: 他们去年为这项设计取得了版权。
senses.why: A right is not a wall until someone writes it down.
senses.whyCN: 权利在被人写下来之前，还算不上一道墙。

senses.title: Protected by that right
senses.definition: covered by the legal right that forbids copying
senses.definitionCN: 处于禁止他人复制的法律权利之下
senses.example: The image is copyright material.
senses.exampleCN: 这张图片是受版权保护的材料。
senses.why: The word turns from a thing owned into a fence standing around it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从一件被拥有的东西，变成围着它的一道篱笆。

intro.en: Copyright joins copy, from Latin copia, plenty, with right, from Old English riht, a just claim.
intro.cn: copyright 由 copy（源自拉丁语 copia，丰富）与 right（源自古英语 riht，正当要求）合成。

items.en: Copia meant plenty, and later a transcript of a text.
items.cn: copia 意为丰富，后来指文本的抄本。

items.en: Riht meant what is just, lawful or due to a person.
items.cn: riht 意为公正的、合法的、某人应得的。

items.en: Copy named a written transcript, and right named a claim.
items.cn: copy 指书面抄本，right 指一项主张。

items.en: A printing law gave authors a limited right over their copies.
items.cn: 一部印刷法赋予作者对其印本的有限权利。

items.en: Copyright spread worldwide as printing and publishing grew.
items.cn: 随着印刷与出版发展，copyright 传遍世界。

items.en: It now covers songs, films, software and images.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖歌曲、电影、软件与图像。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the copy base, and the meaning group names other legal rights over ideas and works.
note.cn: 形近组共享 copy 词基，近义组列出其他关于作品与创意的法律权利。

entries.definition: a duplicate of an original work
a machine that makes copies
a person who copies documents
the right to be the only maker of an invention
entries.definitionCN: 独享某项发明制造权的权利

entries.definition: a sign that identifies a product legally
entries.definitionCN: 合法标识某产品的标志

entries.definition: a payment made for each copy sold
entries.definitionCN: 每售出一份所付的酬金

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a maker fencing a work, then move to the act of registering and to a fence already standing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从创作者为作品围起篱笆开始，再到登记这道篱笆，最后到已经立好的篱笆。

normal.en: Copyright is simply copy plus right: the right over copies.
normal.cn: copyright 就是 copy 加 right：对副本的权利。

normal.en: The symbol on a book is a small fence around the words.
normal.cn: 书上的那个符号，是围住文字的一道小篱笆。

normal.en: A song can be copied in a second, so the right must be written down.
normal.cn: 一首歌一秒就能被复制，所以这项权利必须写下来。

normal.en: Compare it with patent: one protects a work, the other an invention.
normal.cn: 和 patent 比一比：一个保护作品，一个保护发明。

normal.en: The verb is young, and it means to put that fence in place.
normal.cn: 动词用法出现较晚，意思是把这道篱笆立起来。

abstract.en: Picture a small fence around a single printed page.
abstract.cn: 想象一道小篱笆围着一页印好的纸。

abstract.en: Picture a name written at the foot of a song.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌的末尾写着一个名字。

abstract.en: Picture a key that locks a box of copies.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙锁住一箱副本。

examples.en: The publisher owns the copyright to the novel.
examples.cn: 出版社拥有这部小说的版权。

examples.en: They copyrighted the software in three countries.
examples.cn: 他们在三个国家为这款软件取得了版权。

examples.en: You may not post copyright material without permission.
examples.cn: 未经许可，你不得发布受版权保护的材料。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 copyright 记成 copy（复制）加 right（权利）：决定谁能复制的权利，就是版权。

root: 由 copy（源自拉丁语 copia，抄本）与 right（古英语 riht，正当权利）合成，十八世纪印刷法促成其法律含义，现指著作权。

sensesIntro.en: From a maker fencing a work, to the act of raising the fence, and at last to the fence standing around the work.
sensesIntro.cn: 从创作者为作品围起篱笆，到立起篱笆的动作，最后到已经围在作品周围的篱笆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small fence around a printed page.
core.cn: 核心意象：围着印好纸页的一道小篱笆。

branches.en: A creator holds a right over every copy of the work.
branches.cn: 创作者对作品的每一份副本都握有权利。

branches.en: Registering turns an idea of ownership into a fact on paper.
branches.cn: 登记把归属的念头变成纸上的事实。

branches.en: A work already fenced is marked as protected.
branches.cn: 已经围上篱笆的作品被标明受到保护。

branches.en: The right and the act of claiming it are two stages.
branches.cn: 权利本身与主张权利的动作是两个阶段。

branches.en: Once claimed, the work stays marked as protected.
branches.cn: 一旦主张，作品就持续被标为受保护。

intro.en: Copyright is a compound of copy and right, and it takes -ed and -able in English.
intro.cn: copyright 由 copy 与 right 复合而成，在英语里可加 -ed 与 -able。

latinIntro.en: The copy half goes back to Latin copia, plenty, which also gives copious.
latinIntro.cn: copy 这一半可追溯到拉丁语 copia（丰富），它也带来了 copious。

items.meaning: the right over copies of a work
items.meaningCN: 对作品副本所享的权利

items.meaning: able to be protected by copyright

items.exampleCN: 一名抄写员做了这份抄本。

items.example: She has a right to reply.

definition_en: a thick string, an electrical wire with a cover, or a cord-like part of the body
core_image: 一根细绳绕在手上，勒出浅浅的痕
scene: 包裹摊在桌上，他找出一根绳子把它系紧。He tied the parcel with a thin cord.
sceneCN: 这里 cord 指「细绳」（第 1 个义项：较粗的绳子）；句意是他用一根细绳把包裹捆好。

senses.title: A thick string
senses.definition: a length of thick string made of twisted threads
senses.definitionCN: 由多股线捻成的较粗绳子
senses.example: She hung the curtain with a silk cord.
senses.exampleCN: 她用一根丝绳挂起窗帘。
senses.why: Twisting many weak threads makes one strong line.
senses.whyCN: 把许多细弱的线捻在一起，就成了一条结实的线。

senses.title: An electrical cable
senses.definition: a covered wire that carries electricity to a device
senses.definitionCN: 把电送到电器的包皮导线
senses.example: The lamp cord was too short.
senses.exampleCN: 台灯的电线太短了。
senses.why: Power also needs a path, and the path is named like a string.
senses.whyCN: 电也需要一条路，而这条路就用绳子的名字来叫。

senses.title: A cord-like body part
senses.definition: a long thin part of the body that looks like a cord
senses.definitionCN: 身体中细长如绳的部分
senses.example: The spinal cord carries signals from the brain.
senses.exampleCN: 脊髓把信号从大脑传出去。
senses.why: Inside the body, nerves also travel in long twisted bundles.
senses.whyCN: 身体内部，神经也是成束地长距离行走。

intro.en: Cord comes from Greek khorde, a string of gut, through Latin chorda and Old French corde.
intro.cn: cord 来自希腊语 khorde（肠弦），经拉丁语 chorda 与古法语 corde 进入英语。

items.en: Khorde meant a string made from animal gut.
items.cn: khorde 意为用动物肠子做的弦。

items.en: Chorda named a string for a musical instrument.
items.cn: chorda 指乐器的弦。

items.en: Old French corde widened the sense to any strong string.
items.cn: 古法语 corde 把词义扩大到任何结实的绳子。

items.en: English cord named rope used in daily work.
items.cn: 英语 cord 指日常劳作所用的绳。

items.en: Electricity gave the word the sense of a covered wire.
items.cn: 电的应用让这个词获得了包皮电线的含义。

items.en: The body sense survives in spinal cord and vocal cords.
items.cn: 身体义项保留在 spinal cord 与 vocal cords 中。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin string base cord-, and the meaning group names other things that tie or carry power.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的弦词基 cord-，近义组列出其他用于捆扎或导电的东西。

entries.definition: several musical notes played together
an official agreement between sides
friendly and warm in manner
a very strong thick cord
a thin cord used for tying
a thin metal thread for power

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with twisted threads in a hand, then move to a lamp cable and to the spine.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从手里捻起的细线开始，再到台灯的电线，最后到脊柱。

normal.en: Cord and chord sound the same but live in different worlds: one ties, one sings.
normal.cn: cord 与 chord 读音相同却分居两界：一个捆东西，一个唱歌。

normal.en: Twist several threads and you get a cord; twist many cords and you get a rope.
normal.cn: 几股线捻起来是 cord，许多 cord 再捻起来就是 rope。

normal.en: A lamp cord is just a string that carries power.
normal.cn: 台灯的电线，不过是一根送电的绳子。

normal.en: The spinal cord is a cord inside the backbone.
normal.cn: 脊髓就是脊柱里的一根索带。

normal.en: The -less form, cordless, means free of that string.
normal.cn: 加 -less 的 cordless，就是摆脱了那根线。

abstract.en: Picture three threads twisted into one line.
abstract.cn: 想象三股线被捻成一条。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp cord curling across a wooden floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一根灯线弯曲着铺在木地板上。

abstract.en: Picture a long white cord running down a spine.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长长的白色索带沿脊柱而下。

examples.en: She cut a length of cord to tie the box.
examples.cn: 她剪了一截细绳来捆箱子。

examples.en: Unplug the cord before you move the lamp.
examples.cn: 搬动台灯之前先拔掉电线。

examples.en: Damage to the spinal cord can be serious.
examples.cn: 脊髓受损可能很严重。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cord 记成几股线拧成的一根：能捆东西的是绳，能送电的是线，长在身体里的是索。

root: 源自希腊语 khorde（肠弦），经拉丁语 chorda（琴弦）与古法语 corde 进入英语，由琴弦引申为细绳、电线与索状组织。

sensesIntro.en: From a twisted string, to a cable carrying power, and at last to a cord inside the body.
sensesIntro.cn: 从捻成的细绳，到输送电力的电线，最后到身体里的一根索带。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin cord wound around a hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根细绳绕在手上。

branches.en: Twisted threads make a line strong enough to tie.
branches.cn: 捻起的线做成一条足够结实的捆扎线。

branches.en: A covered line carries power to a machine.
branches.cn: 包皮的线把电送到机器上。

branches.en: A cord in the body carries signals instead of current.
branches.cn: 身体里的索带传的是信号，不是电流。

branches.en: Both are long flexible lines with a job.
